meta.description: Passes an attested [trivy](https://github.com/aquasecurity/trivy) vulnerability report only when every finding has a severity the verifier explicitly allowed. Each severity has its own boolean context value, all off by default, so the policy fails on any finding unless its severity was enabled.
meta.name: Allowed Trivy Severities

disallowedCount.code: has(predicate.data.Results) ? size(predicate.data.Results.map(r, has(r.Vulnerabilities), r.Vulnerabilities).flatten().filter(v, !((v.Severity.lowerAscii() == 'critical' && context.allowCritical) || (v.Severity.lowerAscii() == 'high' && context.allowHigh) || (v.Severity.lowerAscii() == 'medium' && context.allowMedium) || (v.Severity.lowerAscii() == 'low' && context.allowLow) || (v.Severity.lowerAscii() == 'unknown' && context.allowUnknown)))) : 0

error.message: Attested trivy report has {{ .Outputs.disallowedCount }} vulnerabilities with a disallowed severity
error.guidance: Remediate the vulnerabilities or enable their severity level via the allow* policy context values

assessment.message: All attested trivy vulnerabilities have an allowed severity
